Who introduced him to these powerful circles? What made senior officials seek his assistance? Was he offering access to influential decision-makers, facilitating promotions, attempting to influence judicial proceedings, or trading in sensitive government information? Most importantly, was Inam Sapkota the mastermind of this network, merely a facilitator, or just one visible link in a much bigger system? Nepal deserves answers.
